mapper.insert: insert into sys_menu (parent_id, name, url, type, icon, order_num, access, component, com_name, is_show) VALUES (#{menu.parentId}, #{menu.name}, #{menu.url}, #{menu.type}, #{menu.icon}, #{menu.orderNum}, #{menu.access}, #{menu.component}, #{menu.comName}, #{menu.isShow})

insert into sys_menu (id, parent_id, name, url, type, icon, order_num, access, component, com_name, is_show) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.parentId}, #{item.name}, #{item.url},#{item.type}, #{item.icon}, #{item.orderNum}, #{item.access}, #{item.component}, #{item.comName}, #{item.isShow})
mapper.select: select sm.*, (select sm1.`name` from sys_menu sm1 where sm1.id = sm.parent_id) as parentName from sys_menu sm order by parent_id, order_num, id

update.foreach:
update sys_menu set
name=#{item.name},
url=#{item.url},
parent_id=#{item.parentId},
type=#{item.type},
icon=#{item.icon},
order_num=#{item.orderNum},
access=#{item.access},
component=#{item.component},
com_name=#{item.comName},
is_show=#{item.isShow},
id=#{item.id} where id = #{item.id}
